caption:
This #InternationalYouthDay is a reflective one for me. The theme of the day - Different Contexts, Common Aspirations - is particularly centred around young people living, working, and growing in #LeastDevelopedCountries, #LandlockedDevelopingCountries and #SmallIslandDeveloping States (SIDS). Settings where I've spent the majority of my UN career. And, our recent collaboration with @Goodwall has highlighted what these three different contexts have in common: energy.
 
From the urgent needs of last-mile energy infrastructure in least developed settings, to the crucial collaborations driving cross-border energy infrastructure in landlocked countries - as well as the phenomenal renewable energy potential of SIDS - the common aspiration we need to be talking about this International Youth Day is that of a just energy transition that works for all people. Everywhere. And where young people are the drivers of this transition.
 
So, to empower young people at this crucial juncture we're meeting them where they are. Through the NextGen Energy Champions Initiative — a partnership between UNDP and Goodwall — youth aged 16 to 30, anywhere in the world, can use gamified learning on the Goodwall platform to:

→ Watch curated videos on clean energy technology, policy, and careers

→ Complete knowledge quizzes

→ Record a 30-second video sharing their perspective on #CleanEnergy

Because a just energy transition isn’t built for young people. It’s built with them.

Aged 16 to 30? Download Goodwall and take on the challenge.

Work with youth? Please share this post.
